label: Черта
description: A 10-sentence usage card for черта (trait; line).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Черта' is the feminine nominative noun describing a character trait. 'Хорошая' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'очень' intensifies the praise.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Черту' is the accusative direct object of 'ценю'. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative and 'характера' is genitive showing a trait of character.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Черты' is the genitive after 'нет'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'у него' shows whose trait is lacking.
Strategic focus: Dative apposition. 'Черте' is the dative form after 'как', agreeing with the dative 'доброте' it describes. 'Рады' takes the dative and 'всегда' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Чертой' is instrumental because 'отличаться' governs the instrumental case. 'Одной важной' agrees in the feminine instrumental and 'он' is the subject.

missions.phrase: В этой черте видна его доброта.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В черте' uses the prepositional form 'черте' after 'в'. 'Этой' agrees and 'доброта' is the nominative subject seen in the trait.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Черта' is the feminine nominative subject of 'делает'. 'Особенным' is the instrumental complement describing the result, and 'его' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Черт' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Прекрасных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'у неё' shows whose traits.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Черты' is the nominative plural subject. 'Лица' is genitive in the phrase for facial features and 'красивы' is the short-form predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object, concrete sense. 'Черту' is the accusative object of 'провёл' in the literal meaning of drawing a line. 'Прямую' agrees and 'художник' is the subject.
